audit_entry_form.aef_label: Form field label. Shown above the URL input field on the audit entry form.
audit_entry_form.aef_submit_button: Button label. Submits the URL and starts the audit.
audit_entry_form.aef_subtxt: Informational text shown below the audit entry form. Describes what the tool does and states the current request count and rate limit. Contains HTML structure — preserve all tags. Contains placeholders for time window, request count, and limit.
audit_entry_form.aef_url_not_valid: Inline validation error. Shown below the URL input field when the entered URL is not valid.

card_1.title: Fact card title. Shown as a heading on the card displayed while the audit is running.
card_1.text: Fact card body text. One to two sentences with a concrete, sourced fact relevant to web auditing, sustainability, performance, accessibility, or security.
card_1.source: Fact card source attribution. Short reference shown in small text below the fact.

audit_error_msg.title: Error page heading. Shown at the top of the error state when an audit fails.
audit_error_msg.msg_1: Error explanation paragraph. Shown below the error heading. Explains the most likely technical reason for the failure (AWS Lambda IP blocking).

error_types.default: Error type label. Shown when no specific error type is identified.
error_types.could_not_load_page: Error type label. Shown when the target page could not be fetched.
error_types.unable_to_process_request: Error type label and message. Shown when the PageSpeed API returns a 500 error. Includes a suggested action.
error_types.limit: Error type label and message. Shown when the user has exceeded the request rate limit. Contains placeholders for the limit number and time window.
error_types.abuse_ipdb_possibly_down: Error type label and message. Shown when the AbuseIPDB API is unreachable.
error_types.initial_fetch_invalid_url: Error type label. Shown when the submitted URL is not valid.
error_types.initial_fetch_too_many_redirects: Error type label. Shown when the target URL has a redirect loop.
error_types.initial_fetch_catch: Error type label and message. Shown when the initial HTTP fetch fails with a client or server error.
error_types.initial_fetch_request_timeout: Error type label and message. Shown when the initial fetch times out.
error_types.catch_greencheck: Error type label and message. Shown when the Green Web Foundation API is unavailable.
error_types.catch_http_observatory: Error type label and message. Shown when the HTTP Observatory analysis fails.
error_types.catch_web_risk: Error type label and message. Shown when the Google Web Risk check fails.
error_types.web_risk_quota: Error type label and message. Shown when the Web Risk API daily quota is exceeded.

audit_error_msg.details: Button or toggle label. Expands a panel showing technical error details. Single word.
audit_error_msg.close: Button label. Closes the error dialog or panel. Single word.

wait_for_audit_results.audit_runs: Status label shown on the loading modal while the audit is in progress. Short, 2-3 words.
wait_for_audit_results.msg_1: Loading modal message for a new audit. Tells the user the audit is running and they will be redirected automatically. Shown when a new audit is triggered.
wait_for_audit_results.msg_2: Loading modal message for an audit update. Same structure as msg_1 but used when an existing audit is being refreshed rather than run for the first time.

form_info.rate_limit_exceeded: Inline info message shown on the form when the rate limit is exceeded before submission. Contains placeholders for the limit number and time window.
form_info.bot_detected: Inline info message shown on the form when a bot is detected. Explains that only human users can submit requests.
